svg.text: Engineering evidence search: MVP system design
Two ways in, one service: text questions through the FTS5 index, table questions through SQL that the chat agent writes · permissions before any limit, count or join · every answer cites its file
QUERY PLANE · ANSWERED WITHIN THE 8 S BUDGET, OR REFUSED AT ONCE (503 BUSY, RETRY-AFTER)
Table questions: the chat agent writes SQL (ADR 0016)
query_sql → permissions on every file → in-memory projection of
the permitted rows only → authoriser, query_only, step budget,
≤ 500 rows → audit (SQL hash, no rows) · rows cite file and line
Safe, not necessarily right: the SQL is scored by evaluation (ADR 0019)
answer · file · page · lines · SHA-256 version · request ID
SQLite files · the web service and MCP servers share them · index-<id>.lock: one process publishes at a time
keyword + structured store · WAL · one transaction per update
INGESTION PLANE · AT START, ON REINDEX AND ON UPLOAD
Install and test the MCP server
Full guide: docs/MCP.md · Python 3.11+ and uv · the chat client starts the server on your computer and talks to it over stdio
uv run --frozen python -m scripts.check_mcp --user kamal → 6 S355 rows under 5 kN/m², “The MCP server works.”
claude in the repository folder: .mcp.json starts the server as jp (approve it once) · claude mcp list
codex mcp add engineering_search -- uv run --frozen --directory "$PWD" python -m engineering_search.mcp_server --user kamal
pi in the repository folder (trusted project): .pi/mcp.json starts the server as jp · pi mcp list
Ask the questions in docs/MCP.md as each user, including the SQL ones. Read the SQL in each tool call. Report the request_id of each problem.
Kamal must get no text, row, file name or count from project-northgate/, specifications/ or the Harbour roof schedule. Report it at once.
The server trusts --user. It does not match the person who uses the MCP client to the file permissions. Anyone who can edit the client configuration can read as JP.
Fix before real restricted files: remote MCP server with OAuth sign-in, user from the token, permissions from the repository.
29 October 2026, 148 files · scripts.evaluate, scripts.load_test and pytest · plan in ADR 0019
